name: Kenny Deemer
career_history: Preconstruction Manager at The Beck Group, 4/2019 to present; Senior Estimator at Kiewit, 11/2012 to 4/2019; Estimator at Tetra Tech, 4/2012 to 10/2012; Lead Estimator at Saunders Construction, 4/2008 to 9/2011; Estimator II at M A Mortenson, 8/2003 to 4/2008; Electrical Estimator at Riviera Electric, 7/1999 to 7/2003; Summer Intern at Riviera Electric, 5/1998 to 8/1998
education: B.S., Building Construction Management, Purdue University
biography:
Kenny has ten+ years of experience in Estimating and Preconstruction for projects ranging from 10M to 100M+. Kenny has a proven track record of delivering high quality pre-construction services and detailed cost estimates that exceed industry standards.

Kenny has distinguished himself in the construction industry for utilizing 3-D Building Information Models for quantity survey. Kenny was involved in the pre-release customer testing of Autodesk Quantity Survey (QTO) for Autodesk Inc. providing detailed feed back on how an estimators would use this software. Kenny is a two-time Autodesk University Speaker on the use of QTO. Furthermore, Kenny has successfully integrated a third-party estimating system with QTO providing a true 5D estimating solution.

As a diversion from his desk job, Kenny competes as a Professional Mountain Bike Racer at Regional and National events. He also races as a CAT II in Cyclo-Cross events in the off-season.

Specialties: BIM 5D Cost Modeling.
Detailed cost estimates based on well researched cost data and vendor input.
Pro-Active approach foreseeing constructability issues at early design phases.
Value Analysis, while preserving project design goals.
Clearly communicating budgets to clients.
L.E.E.D Credit Evaluation and Guidance.
Sub-Contractor procurement, bid solicitation and evaluation.
